line: An amber LED board plays one real Wednesday of Hong Kong's cross-harbour buses, first light to 5 a.m.: no tunnel is drawn under the harbour, the morning rush lights all three.
line_cn: 一块琥珀色点阵屏，放香港过海巴士真实的一个星期三，从天亮到次日清晨五点：海底下没有画任何隧道，是早高峰的车流把三条隧道照亮的。
uses: A city's buses, trams or ferries through one day, from a real timetable
Departures, arrivals and frequencies: how often, how many, when
One route or one crossing, followed stop by stop
